online.label: Online
online.description: The device is connected to the OnOffMyPC service.

offline.label: Offline
offline.description: The device is not currently connected. Show its last contact time when known.

unknown.label: Status unavailable
unknown.evidence: Live connection status could not be established
unknown.description: Do not present an API failure as proof that the device is offline.

on.label: On
on.evidence: Latest timestamped PC power telemetry reported on
on.description: Always show when the state was observed.

off.label: Off
off.evidence: Latest timestamped PC power telemetry reported off
off.description: Always show when the state was observed.

stale.label: Last reported state
stale.evidence: A power report exists but is older than the product freshness threshold
stale.description: Use ‘Last reported On/Off’ instead of presenting a stale value as current.

unknown.label: Not reported
unknown.evidence: No usable timestamped PC power telemetry
unknown.description: Never infer PC state from connection state or command acknowledgement.

pending.label: Queued
pending.evidence: The service accepted the request but has not recorded a socket write
pending.description: Show the expiry time and make clear that the physical action has not occurred.

sent.label: Awaiting acknowledgement
sent.evidence: A write to an open device socket was attempted
sent.description: A socket write is not proof that the device processed the request.

delivered.label: Device acknowledged
delivered.evidence: The authenticated device acknowledged receipt or action initiation
delivered.description: Never label this Success, Complete, or PC confirmed.

expired.label: Expired
expired.evidence: The service expiry window elapsed without acknowledgement
expired.description: State that no further attempt will be made.

confirmed.label: PC state confirmed
confirmed.evidence: Future command-linked timestamped telemetry confirms the requested physical result
confirmed.description: Do not render until the backend supplies this evidence explicitly.
